overall.headline: Storm winds and rain hit Pacifica this morning; Iran widened its Gulf attacks to Kuwait.
overall.bluf: A Wind Advisory for the Pacifica coast runs until 1 PM today with gusts to about 44 mph and 1–2 inches of rain, and a High Surf Advisory follows from 4 PM through Thursday; power outages are possible. Abroad, Iran fired on a US air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain after US strikes on an Iranian missile site, while Trump landed in China ahead of a Thursday three-way meeting with Xi and Putin. No FEMA emergency alerts are active for Pacifica.

local.note: Wind Advisory, heavy rain, surf advisory.

regional.note: Sierra winter storm; US tech outages.

world.note: Iran widens Gulf attacks; Yemen offensive.

changes: Updated: The Wind Advisory now ends at 1 PM today. A High Surf Advisory runs 4 PM today to 4 PM Thursday, replacing the Beach Hazards Statement that expires at 4 PM.
New: Iran fired on a US air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain after American strikes on an Iranian missile site; Bahrain issued two shelter alerts.
New: Saudi-led coalition struck about 60 Houthi sites as Houthis pushed toward Aden and fired cruise missiles at Riyadh.
New: Trump landed in China; NPR says the three-way meeting with Xi and Putin is Thursday.
New: Rubio says there is 'zero evidence' linking recent Microsoft, bank, FAA and NSANet outages to an attack; the classified NSANet outage was reported Tuesday.
New: The US lost its measles elimination status, with over 5,400 cases this year.

Dropped as stale: Moss Beach/Pescadero Hwy 1 one-way work (no new Caltrans entry past today), DreamHost control-panel maintenance, Hormuz mine report (no new reporting), Bangladesh, Thaci and Rwanda hub items.

coming_up.title: High Surf Advisory on the coast
coming_up.detail: Surf about 3.7–3.9 m; stay off beaches, rocks and jetties.

coming_up.title: More rain, about half to three-quarters of an inch
coming_up.detail: Rain and possible thunderstorms before 2 PM, then drying Friday.

coming_up.title: Trump, Xi and Putin three-way meeting
coming_up.detail: NPR reports the meeting in China is set for Thursday.

coming_up.title: Winter Storm Warnings, Sierra and Siskiyou
coming_up.detail: NWS Reno warnings run to Friday 4 AM; Medford to Thursday 4 AM. Mountain travel will be difficult.

coming_up.title: Next round of rain
coming_up.detail: NWS forecast shows rain returning Saturday afternoon and likely Sunday.

coming_up.title: King tides begin
coming_up.detail: KQED says the year's highest tides run through January, with possible coastal flooding.

home_front.summary: Wind Advisory until 1 PM and heavy rain; no FEMA alerts.

items.title: Wind Advisory and heavy rain until 1 PM today
items.detail: NWS has a Wind Advisory for Pacifica until 1 PM Wednesday, with south-southwest gusts to about 44–46 mph. Another 1–2 inches of rain and possible thunderstorms are forecast today, with more rain Thursday. Ground is saturated, so slides and fallen branches are more likely.
items.action: This morning, stay off coastal roads where you can, avoid driving a tall vehicle in peak gusts, keep phones and power banks charged, and keep storm drains near the house clear.

items.title: High Surf Advisory from 4 PM today to 4 PM Thursday
items.detail: NWS issued the advisory at 3:25 AM today; the Beach Hazards Statement ends at 4 PM. Surf is forecast near 3.7–3.9 m through Thursday. Stay off jetties, piers and rocks and never turn your back on the ocean.

home_front.summary: No Pacifica outage reports found; wind risk until 1 PM.

items.title: Power outages possible in this morning's wind
items.detail: I found no reported PG&E outage in Pacifica as of early morning, but gusts to 44 mph on saturated ground can bring down lines. The PG&E outage map is the live source.
items.action: If power fails, report it at pge.com/outages, keep the fridge closed, and use flashlights rather than candles.

home_front.summary: Wet, windy roads; Hwy 1 work south of town.

items.title: Hwy 1 one-way traffic at Moss Beach and near Pescadero today
items.detail: Caltrans lists one-way traffic control for drainage work at Moss Beach and slide repair near Pescadero on Nov 18. Expect delays south of Pacifica, worse in rain. Flooding at low spots on Hwy 1 in Pacifica is possible in heavy rain.

home_front.summary: Air quality good (AQI 34); no local advisories.

default.task: Check that flashlights have fresh batteries and the weather radio works.
default.why: Wind and rain are hitting this morning, with more rain Thursday and again this weekend.

3d.why: Heavy rain and wind can disrupt service or cause boil-water notices.

ladder.summary: Storm today; king tides next week.

items.title: King tides expected next week
items.detail: KQED says the year's highest tides arrive next week and run through January, with possible coastal flooding and street closures. No new reporting since Nov 17.

ladder.summary: Sierra storm; High Wind Warning in the Bay Area.

items.title: Winter Storm Warnings for Tahoe, Mono and Siskiyou
items.detail: NWS Reno warnings run until Friday 4 AM and NWS Medford warnings until Thursday 4 AM. Mountain travel will be difficult.

items.title: Prosecutors ask state Supreme Court to block Newsom's death-sentence commutations
items.detail: CalMatters reports the request was filed Monday and Tuesday. No household action needed.

ladder.summary: Tech outages probed; measles status lost.

items.title: Microsoft, bank, FAA and NSANet outages: no sign of attack, officials say
items.detail: Rubio says there is 'zero evidence' that recent disruptions are connected. Microsoft blamed a network upgrade and the FAA a system upgrade; Defense One reports a classified NSANet outage with no immediate sign of a cyberattack. Confirmed causes are still limited.
items.action: Keep some cash on hand and check balances through a second channel if your bank app fails.

items.title: US loses measles elimination status
items.detail: BBC reports more than 5,400 cases and 10 measles-related deaths this year. Check that family vaccinations are up to date.

items.title: Trump says US takes any Iranian plot against Washington 'very seriously'
items.detail: BBC reports Tehran rejects as baseless any suggestion it plotted a dirty-bomb attack on the US capital. The underlying intelligence claim is unconfirmed; a White House spokesperson has said there are no credible threats to the homeland.
items.action: No action; follow official DHS and local alerts if this changes.

items.title: Stocks lower, volatility elevated
items.detail: The S&P 500 fell about 1% and the VIX is 24, up about 38% in five days. Oil eased: WTI about $84. The 10-year yield is 5.10%.

ladder.summary: Crimea bridge aftermath; EU Rwanda hubs.

items.title: Crimea bridge partly collapsed after Ukrainian attack
items.detail: BBC reports Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapsed on Tuesday; Zelensky called it an 'unprecedented' attack. Russia struck Kyiv bridges in the same period. Putin still meets Trump and Xi Thursday.
items.action: Watch for Russian retaliation and grain or energy price effects.

items.title: Criticism grows over EU Rwanda return hubs
items.detail: Al Jazeera and the Guardian report rights groups and politicians criticising the plan by five EU states; no household effect.

ladder.summary: Trump in China; Russian jets near Japan.

items.title: Trump lands in China; three-way meeting with Xi and Putin Thursday
items.detail: Xi greeted Trump at Shenzhen. The US issued chip-export curbs on Southeast Asia, and Trump says he would like to meet Kim Jong Un.

items.title: Japan scrambled jets after alleged Russian airspace incursion
items.detail: Taiwan and South Korea also responded to Russian aircraft near their airspace, per BBC on Nov 17. No newer reporting.

ladder.summary: Iran widens Gulf attacks; Yemen offensive.

items.title: Iran fires on US air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain
items.detail: AP says Iran targeted a US air base in Kuwait after American strikes on an Iranian missile site; Kuwait says its defenses intercepted drones and Bahrain issued two shelter alerts. This follows Iran's strikes on a US radar site in Bahrain.
items.action: If strikes widen, expect fuel and shipping effects; keep the car's tank at least half full.

items.title: Saudi coalition hits 60 Houthi sites as Houthis push toward Aden
items.detail: Al Jazeera reports fierce fighting in Taiz. AP says Houthis fired two cruise missiles at Riyadh; Saudi Arabia intercepted one. Red Sea shipping risk stays high.
items.action: Watch for shipping and fuel price effects.

items.title: Rare protests in southwestern Iran after crash kills 13 refinery workers
items.detail: Hundreds rallied in Abdanan demanding officials resign, per AP.
